prompt:
Research the official free-tier limits of the GitHub Actions service for public and private repositories (minutes, storage, concurrency). Cite the GitHub documentation page you used.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

If you're not sure about something, just say so.

response.content:
Based on the GitHub documentation, here are the free-tier limits for GitHub Actions:

**For Public Repositories:**
- Standard GitHub-hosted runners are free and unlimited for public repositories
- This includes minutes, concurrency, and storage usage
- Larger runners are always charged, even for public repositories

**For Private Repositories:**
Free usage is limited by plan-based quotas that reset monthly:

SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/billing/managing-billing-for-github-actions/about-billing-for-github-actions | QUOTE: "For private repositories, each GitHub account receives a quota of free minutes, artifact storage, and cache storage for use with GitHub-hosted runners, depending on the account's plan." | CLAIM: Private repositories have limited free usage based on account plan

SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/billing/concepts/product-billing/github-actions | QUOTE: "GitHub Free: 500 MB | 2,000 | 10 GB" | CLAIM: GitHub Free plan includes 500MB artifact storage, 2,000 minutes, and 10GB cache storage monthly

SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/billing/concepts/product-billing/github-actions | QUOTE: "GitHub Pro: 1 GB | 3,000 | 10 GB" | CLAIM: GitHub Pro plan includes 1GB artifact storage, 3,000 minutes, and 10GB cache storage monthly

SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/billing/concepts/product-billing/github-actions | QUOTE: "GitHub Team: 2 GB | 3,000 | 10 GB" | CLAIM: GitHub Team plan includes 2GB artifact storage, 3,000 minutes, and 10GB cache storage monthly

SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/billing/concepts/product-billing/github-actions | QUOTE: "GitHub Enterprise Cloud: 50 GB | 50,000 | 10 GB" | CLAIM: GitHub Enterprise Cloud plan includes 50GB artifact storage, 50,000 minutes, and 10GB cache storage monthly

**Concurrency Limits:**
SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/limits | QUOTE: "Standard GitHub-hosted runner | Free | 20 | 5 | Not applicable" | CLAIM: Free plan allows 20 concurrent jobs total, with max 5 concurrent macOS jobs

SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/limits | QUOTE: "Standard GitHub-hosted runner | Pro | 40 | 5 | Not applicable" | CLAIM: Pro plan allows 40 concurrent jobs total, with max 5 concurrent macOS jobs

SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/limits | QUOTE: "Standard GitHub-hosted runner | Team | 60 | 5 | Not applicable" | CLAIM: Team plan allows 60 concurrent jobs total, with max 5 concurrent macOS jobs

SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/limits | QUOTE: "Standard GitHub-hosted runner | Enterprise | 500 | 50 | Not applicable" | CLAIM: Enterprise plan allows 500 concurrent jobs total, with max 50 concurrent macOS jobs

**Additional Notes:**
- Self-hosted runners are always free for both public and private repositories
- Storage limits are shared with GitHub Packages for most plans
- Minutes reset to the full amount at the start of each billing cycle
- Usage beyond free limits is billed at standard rates

NO_SOURCE_FOUND: Specific concurrency limits for public repositories (though they are described as "free and unlimited")
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: Detailed storage breakdown between artifacts, caches, and packages for each plan type
